common.syntheticOnly: Synthetic data only. Never enter a real person's details.

states.errorBody: The request did not complete. Check the connection and try again.
states.noAccessTitle: Not found, or you don't have access
states.noAccessBody: This record does not exist, or it belongs to a facility you are not assigned to.
states.notFoundBody: This address does not match any page.

login.title: Staff sign in
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check the connection and try again.
login.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.heroBody: A shared workspace for coordinators, nurses, ASHAs and doctors.
login.pointSharedPhone: Built for shared phones: one number never merges two people.
login.pointUnknown: Nothing is guessed: unknown stays unknown.
login.pointFacility: You see only the records of the facilities you work at.
login.subtitle: Sign in with the account your administrator gave you.

find.title: Find an existing mother
find.intro: Search only finds records at facilities you are assigned to. A shared phone number never merges people: each match is listed separately.
find.name: Name (partial matches)
find.needOneField: Enter a phone number, a name, or both.
find.emptyBody: No match in your facilities. If this mother is new here, use "Register new mother".
find.startBody: Search by phone, name or both. If the mother is not found, register her with "Register new mother".
find.matchHint: Check the name and age before choosing. A shared phone can belong to more than one person.

register.title: Register a mother and open a pregnancy episode
register.phoneHint: A phone number may be shared by more than one household member. It is never used as anyone's identity.
register.ageHint: Never guess. Choose "Unknown" rather than inventing a date.
register.history: Reported medical history (as told by the family, optional)
register.registeredPending: {{name}} is registered. Opening the pregnancy episode did not finish. Try again.
register.noFacilities: You are not assigned to any facility, so you cannot register a mother. Ask an administrator.

episode.title: Pregnancy episode
episode.motherLoadFailed: Could not load the mother's record.
episode.contactNotConfirmed: Not yet confirmed with the family (staff confirmation only; no OTP).
episode.reloadNote: This record is loaded from the server each time, so reloading the page shows what is saved.

age.notRecorded: Age / date of birth not recorded

guide.title: Before you start
guide.searchFirst: Search first. Register only if she is not found, so the same mother is never registered twice.
guide.sharedPhone: A phone can be shared by a family. Matches are never merged; check the name and age before choosing.
guide.unknown: If something is not known, choose "Unknown". Never guess a date or age.
guide.synthetic: Synthetic data only. Never enter a real person's details.
